'''Seberuang''' is an [[Ibanic languages|Ibanic language]] spoken in the province of [[West Kalimantan]], Indonesia. It is spoken by the Seberuang Dayak people who mainly live in [[Sintang Regency]] (especially in the districts of Sepauk, Tempunak, and parts of Sintang) and parts of [[Sekadau Regency]] (only in Belitang district).<ref>{{cite journal|url=https://jurnal.stkippersada.ac.id/jurnal/index.php/KAN/article/view/949|title=Dialek Sosial Bahasa Dayak Seberuang di Desa Sukau Bersatu Kecamatan Sepauk Kabupaten Sintang|journal=KANSASI: Jurnal Pendidikan Bahasa dan Sastra Indonesia|language=id|year=2018|volume=3|number=2|doi=10.31932/jpbs.v3i2.949|doi-access=free|issn=2540-7996|first1=U.D.|last1=Oktaviani|first2=Y.|last2=Susanti|author3=Munika|publisher=Persada Khatulistiwa College of Teacher Training and Education|location=[[Sintang]]|pages=82–89}}</ref> In addition, the speakers also live along the upper Seberuang River and also on the southern provincial road that connects Semitau with [[Putussibau]], the capital of [[Kapuas Hulu Regency]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://kalimantanreview.com/asal-usul-dayak-seberuang/|title=Asal Usul Dayak Seberuang|website=kalimantanreview.com|publisher=Kalimantan Review|language=id|access-date=5 December 2025|date=31 August 2017|first=Adelbertus|last=Asisi}}</ref>
